name: Stygian-Polje
description: A single unbroken ocean swallows the horizon, its color shifting from wine-dark deeps to bright shelf-teal. The only interruptions are subterranean ocean, breaking the swell in a ragged arc.

Standing still, you feel the cold air press in like a verdict. Wind is the only voice here, and it repeats itself. The only confirmed life is microbial, a chemosynthetic film that glows faintly where the ground weeps warmth.
Local legend among spacers says the planet hums on a frequency just below hearing. Instruments confirm it. Nobody agrees on the source.
Opportunity here wears armor. Claims on biomass, exotic matter, medicinal compounds and fusion fuel are staked, defended, and occasionally avenged, and the nearest law is a week's burn away.
